text:
Devon: Thinking of using the weekend to either drive up the coast for sunrise surf (:car::surfing_man:) or finally tackling the apartment deep-clean and donating all the things. what are you all doing?
Anya: roadtrip!! bring snacks. also can we stop at that taco truck? :taco:
Samir: deep-clean for me. finally building a bookshelf so my plants have room.
Maria: Roadtrip sounds dreamy but I promised to help my neighbor move boxes. :sweat_smile:
Kevin: If y'all go, count me in for the taco stop. otherwise i'm just planning to binge a terrible sci-fi movie and order delivery. :popcorn:
Luca: Also tempted to set up a tiny vinyl-listening sesh at my place if we stay local — bring records :notes:
Devon: @Kevin noted — tacos are a must. @Maria good luck with the move :muscle:
Anya: @Maria we can swing by later and help? half-day swap?
Maria: maybe! if move wraps early i might join the taco caravan :crossed_fingers:
Samir: update: bookshelf assembly is going to require an extra hand. anyone into power-drill bonding? :hammer_and_wrench:
Luca: i'll bring the drill and beers if we do the bookshelf + records plan. :beers:
OpsBot: Reminder: office recycling pickup on Monday morning. Please flatten boxes if you're donating furniture. :recycle:
Devon: Good point OpsBot — if we donate, i'll stash the flattened boxes by the loading dock Sunday evening.
Kevin: vote check — roadtrip (tacos + sunrise) or local (cleaning + vinyl + bookshelf)? I'm 1 vote roadtrip.
Anya: roadtrip :raised_hands:
Samir: local :ok_hand:
Maria: depends on timing but leaning local
Luca: local + records :headphones:
Devon: tally — roadtrip 2, local 3. looks like bookshelf/cleanup/records is winning unless someone flips. final call at 8pm tonight?
Anya: 8pm sounds good. i can be persuaded by sunrise photos though :camera_with_flash:
Kevin: i'll accept defeat for tacos until next weekend. have fun y'all :wave:
Devon: Nice — see you at the loading dock if we're donating/assembling. otherwise i'll send a pic from the coast tomorrow morning :sunrise:
Maria: Good luck with the surf if you go! :surfing_woman:
Samir: Good luck, everyone. and please post pics of the shelf when assembled. :)
